title: The "Secret" Microsoft Tool That Generates Free 3D Models #Trellis2 #Microsoft
description:
You can now turn any image into a high quality 3D model for completely free.
 
• It is called Trellis 2 and it is an open source 3D generator from Microsoft.
• You just go to their site, click on the demo, upload the image you want to model, and click generate.
• It creates a preview design for you first so you can check if you like the results.
• Once you are happy with the preview, you click a button and your 3D model is ready to download.
• You can easily use these generated models for web design and game development.
 
Here is the link: https://microsoft.github.io/TRELLIS.2/
